notes.title: Cat Simulator Update #5
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for your feedback and support!

We are getting lots of questions regarding the difference between "Project CATS" and "Cat Simulator".

As we previously mentioned,

-"Project CATS" and "Cat Simulator" are developed by the same company: CATSTUDIO.

-Project CATS is being redeveloped and will be re-released in the near future containing all the 3rd person game modes

-Cat Simulator is the redeveloped 1st person game mode which was known as "Hunter Mode" originally

-BOTH games are in "Early Access" because they contain bugs (both games are in early access because they have some bugs, we clearly indicated this on our store page)

Please let us know if you have any other questions...

Thank you for your continuous feedback and support!

-CATSTUDIO

notes.title: Cat Simulator Update #3 - What is the difference between Cat Simulator and Project CATS?
notes.content:
Cat Simulator Update #3

We get this question a lot and we want to address it directly:

What is the difference between Cat Simulator and Project CATS?

- Cat Simulator and Project CATS are two very different games.

- Cat Simulator is a fun first-person cat game.

- Project CATS is a collection of fun third-person cat games (it also includes a Cat Screen Saver Mode and a Cat Toy Mode).

- Project CATS is currently being re-designed/updated and will be re-released shortly.

- Cat Simulator is launching next week!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Cat Simulator Update #1
notes.content:
We have fixed the camera angle bug/issue.

This issue was visible at random times. While using the Left-click camera functions the camera would jump to a random orientation on the screen.

This bug has now been fixed.

We are fixing other bugs as well, stay tuned for new updates...
